title: The Nazi Gold Train
hook: Who buried a train of treasure beneath the Polish mountains?
headline: Hidden treasure train in Poland's tunnels

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: After World War II, officers vanished with a train loaded with gold.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: Investigators reported a tunnel entrance near the village of Kłodzko.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: A sonar scan detected an underground cavity filled with metal debris.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: Analysis suggests the cavity housed a railway shelter rather than treasure.

end.line: What really lies beneath the Owl Mountains?

description: Explore the mysterious Nazi gold train legend and recent findings.

facts.claim: In September 1945 SS officers vanished with a train loaded with gold
Polish investigators reported a tunnel entrance near Kłodzko in 2015
A 2016 sonar scan detected a 100-meter underground cavity with metal debris
2023 analysis indicates the cavity likely housed a railway shelter, not treasure

bad: contradicted: tunnel entrance near the village of Kłodzko (spravne: tunnel entrance near Świebodzice/Książ Castle in the Owl Mountains)
